clips.description: 45 humanoid clips on a 53-bone Rigify-style DEF- skeleton, covering everything D7 retargets for a deformable character: Idle_Loop, Walk_Loop, Sword_Attack, Hit_Chest and Death01. Bone-renamed from Rigify to the Unreal naming adapters/retarget_humanoid_motion.py contracts against (see adapters/prepare_donor_motion.py; right side stays at negative X so handedness is unchanged). Converted from the mirror's separate .gltf + .bin into a single .glb so the retarget adapter receives one self-contained file.
clips.author: Quaternius
